purpose: Verified licensed Sketchfab sources and local official masters for bundled museum objects. Research alternatives are not a substitute for user-selected models. This file does not edit catalog.json.

renderer.method: Indexed original geometry, world transforms baked on worker, authored assembly selection before accessor decode, equal-material groups merged without decimating the silhouette.
renderer.handoff: CPU read/decode on worker. Source bytes and JSON freed before upload. Byte-identical image deduplication. One original-resolution material atlas uploaded per frame, then CPU pixels released. Geometry remains indexed and merged by equal material.
renderer.lighting: Neutral fixed studio GGX/Smith/Schlick; metallic energy conservation, exact sRGB colour sampling, linear data sampling, AO indirect-only. Hemisphere indirect environment is an approximation, not source HDR lighting.
